units.does: Unless forced, returns when the last scan is under 7 days old; otherwise starts a detached utility-priority Task that runs recompute(archive:now:).

branches.effect: returns without scanning; else launches Task.detached recompute

flags.text: Throttled only by time: a newly recorded hard run within 7 days of the last scan does not update the FTP (and so power-TSS) until the week passes; the only caller passes force=false.

recomputeIfNeeded returns immediately after launching a detached task, and the launch housekeeping then awaits trainingMetricsCache.refresh() at once, so on a launch that recomputes the FTP the training-load refresh reads the previous cachedRunningFTP; the next refresh rebuilds only because LoadSettings.ftp changed.

Type doc says the estimate is cleared when the anchoring workout was deleted, but nothing reacts to deletion: the only caller is the throttled launch housekeeping, so a deleted anchor keeps scaling power-TSS for up to 7 days.
